findings.description: The new many branches prefix de to full decimal-digit million amounts. De is appropriate after spelled million(s)/millón/millones, not after the exact-number formatting used here. Common million-token totals therefore render ungrammatically.
findings.recommendation: Keep the required many category but render the bare plural noun in it (same noun as other); do not alter remaining/used wrappers or introduce captions. Current number formatting is exact decimal digits, not compact/spelled million.
findings.rule_evidence: OQLF Nombres exacts: when million/milliard are written in figures, La préposition de est absente.
